title: A Gift of Time
transcript: For my mother's birthday, I usually buy flowers. This year, I asked her to choose something we could do together. She surprised me by asking to visit the village where she grew up. We took a bus there and spent the afternoon walking past her old school and the shop where she first worked. I learned more about her life in those few hours than I had in years. Next year, I'll ask her to choose another place.

questions.prompt: Where did the mother want to go this year?
options: The city where the speaker lives.
The village where she was raised.
The town where she last worked.
A school she hoped to attend.
questions.answer: The village where she was raised.
questions.explanation: 母亲想回到自己长大的村庄。

questions.prompt: What did the speaker gain from the trip?
options: A chance to start a new job.
An idea for a school project.
A better understanding of the mother.
questions.answer: A better understanding of the mother.
questions.explanation: 几小时里听到的母亲的人生经历比以往多年了解的还多。
